mainEntity.name: Should I choose a smooth drywall finish or a textured wall finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smooth Level 5 walls provide a sleek, contemporary appearance, but they require significantly more labor, cost, and maintenance than textured finishes. Textured surfaces such as orange peel or knockdown are faster to apply and naturally mask minor framing defects, seasonal stud movement, and surface imperfections. Choosing smooth walls means committing to precise framing, extensive skim-coating, and delicate sanding. Furthermore, smooth walls show everyday scuffs, dents, and patching far more clearly than textured surfaces. If budget or high-traffic durability is a primary concern, textured finishes offer a forgiving, practical tradeoff over ultra-flat smooth walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Textured walls hide framing flaws, scuffs, and patches while costing less. Smooth Level 5 finishes offer a modern look but require extensive skim-coating and show imperfections easily.
